title: #261 Travel for Education
prompt: Some believe the value of travel is highly overrated. 'One brilliant scholar never leaves the home bases.' To what extend do you agree that travel is not a necessary component of a quality education?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Travel provides real-world knowledge by allowing students to see different ways of life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Travel provides real-world knowledge by allowing students to see different ways of life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Travel helps students build social skills by giving them the chance to meet new people from different countries.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Travel helps students build social skills by giving them the chance to meet new people from different countries.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Travel provides real-life knowledge about different places and cultures.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Travel provides real-life knowledge about different places and cultures.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Traveling helps students develop social skills by meeting people from different backgrounds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traveling helps students develop social skills by meeting people from different backgrounds.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Travel provides unique, firsthand knowledge about different ways of life and global cultures that cannot be learned from books, enhancing personal growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Travel provides unique, firsthand knowledge about different ways of life and global cultures that cannot be learned from books, enhancing personal growth.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Traveling helps students develop crucial life skills, such as problem-solving and adaptability, through interactions with diverse people and navigating new environments.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traveling helps students develop crucial life skills, such as problem-solving and adaptability, through interactions with diverse people and navigating new environments.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Travel offers unique chances to learn about different ways of life, allowing students to gain knowledge about local trade and customs that books cannot provide, thus helping them understand global culture.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Travel offers unique chances to learn about different ways of life, allowing students to gain knowledge about local trade and customs that books cannot provide, thus helping them understand global culture.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, travel helps students develop important life skills by forcing them to solve problems in unfamiliar settings, which builds independence and confidence.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, travel helps students develop important life skills by forcing them to solve problems in unfamiliar settings, which builds independence and confidence.
